name: muirdris
text: muirdris is a MacKillop headword naming the older label for the fearsome sea-monster that the hero Fergus mac Léti slays in a lake of Co. Down. MacKillop notes that later texts call the same monster sinach. The full record of this sea-monster tradition sits under the headword sinach.

attributes.attribute: Earlier name for the sea-monster later called sinach; slain by Fergus mac Léti

okr.objective: muirdris is a MacKillop headword for the earlier name of the sea-monster sinach.
key_results: Signpost cites sinach as the canonical headword.
